a: B-tree indexes support equality and range lookups efficiently.
Hash indexes are good for equality but not ranges.
VACUUM FULL rewrites tables and can lock; use carefully.
Always return connections to the pool; leaks exhaust the DB.
Read replicas serve read traffic and improve scale.
Write-heavy workloads need careful indexing and batching.
JSON columns store flexible documents inside relational DBs.
Full-text search indexes words for document retrieval.
Expand/contract migrations avoid downtime during schema changes.
Untested backups are risky; practice restores.
